versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in files for version 1.0.1.
- Documentation, commands, and recommendations remain the same as previous version.
- No new features, fixes, or updates in this release.

- Initial release of csp-policy-generator.
- Generate, validate, and tighten Content Security Policy (CSP) headers for web applications.
- Analyze web pages to discover resource origins and build least-privilege CSP policies.
- Test for CSP violations and provide a safe migration path from report-only to enforcing mode.
- Includes commands to generate, validate, and enhance CSP using nonces and hashes.
